file.reason: Direct match for generic file icon in Lucide

document.reason: File with text lines; tagged 'document, txt, pdf' in Lucide

pdf.reason: No dedicated PDF icon in Lucide; file-text is tagged 'pdf' and represents a document with text

new-folder.reason: Folder with plus sign; standard icon for creating a new folder

open-folder.reason: Direct match for open folder icon in Lucide

archive.reason: Direct match for archive/box icon in Lucide

zip.reason: Lucide file-archive is tagged 'zip, package, archive'; best match for compressed file

attachment.reason: Standard paperclip attachment icon; tagged 'attachment, file' in Lucide

link.reason: Direct match for link/URL icon in Lucide

unlink.reason: Direct match for unlink/disconnect icon in Lucide

image.reason: Direct match for image/photo icon in Lucide

gallery.reason: Multiple overlapping images; tagged 'gallery, album, collection' in Lucide

video.reason: Direct match for video/camera icon in Lucide

camera.reason: Direct match for camera/photo capture icon

camera-off.reason: Direct match for disabled camera icon in Lucide

volume.reason: Speaker with two sound waves representing full volume; Lucide uses volume-2 for normal/high volume

volume-low.reason: Speaker with single sound wave representing low volume; Lucide uses volume-1 for low

mute.reason: Speaker with X mark; tagged 'mute, sound' in Lucide for muted/silenced audio

music.reason: Direct match for music note icon in Lucide

microphone.reason: Lucide uses 'mic' not 'microphone'; standard microphone icon

microphone-off.reason: Lucide uses 'mic-off'; microphone with slash for muted mic

headphones.reason: Direct match for headphones icon in Lucide

podcast.reason: Direct match; tagged 'audio, music, mic, talk, voice' in Lucide

broadcast.reason: Radio tower with signal waves; tagged 'signal, broadcast, live, frequency' in Lucide

crop.reason: Direct match for crop/trim image tool in Lucide

rotate.reason: Clockwise rotation arrow; tagged 'refresh, reload, redo' in Lucide. Chose CW as the default rotation direction

play.reason: Direct match for play triangle media control in Lucide

pause.reason: Direct match for pause (two vertical bars) media control in Lucide

stop.reason: Square shape tagged 'stop, playback, music, audio, video' in Lucide; universal stop button symbol

skip-next.reason: Lucide uses 'skip-forward' for next track; triangle with vertical bar pointing right

skip-previous.reason: Lucide uses 'skip-back' for previous track; triangle with vertical bar pointing left

fast-forward.reason: Direct match for double-triangle fast forward media control

rewind.reason: Direct match for double-triangle rewind media control

shuffle.reason: Direct match for crossed arrows shuffle icon in Lucide

repeat.reason: Direct match for repeat/loop arrows icon in Lucide

record.reason: Circle icon tagged 'record' in Lucide; standard record button is a circle/dot

brush.reason: Tagged 'brush, paintbrush, design, color' in Lucide; represents a paint brush tool

pen.reason: Direct match; tagged 'pencil, draw, writer, ink' in Lucide for writing/drawing tool

color.reason: Eyedropper/pipette tool for picking colors; standard color picker icon in Lucide

eraser.reason: Direct match for eraser/clear tool in Lucide
